newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian castor trade closed for Hindu festival.
newsitem.headline: Indian castor trade closed for Hindu festival.

text.p: Indian castor markets were closed on Thursday for a Hindu festival holiday, dealers said.
On Wednesday, prices for December delivery extended gains on Wednesday on fresh speculative buying and lower arrivals.

Castorseed arrivals from Gujarat region fell to 6-7,000 bags (75 kg each) against 10-12,000 bags on Tuesday. Groundnut oil rose to 435/437 rupees per 10 kg from 432/433 on buying for the festival season. In Rajkot spot oil was steady at 680/685 rupees per 15 kg.
